entries.title: The Very Hungry Caterpillar
entries.details: A beautiful story about a caterpillar eating his way through the week before becoming a butterfly. I loved the colorful illustrations!

entries.title: First Day of School
entries.details: Started first grade! I was a little nervous, but I made three new friends on the first day.

entries.title: Charlotte's Web
entries.details: A heartwarming story about friendship between Wilbur the pig and Charlotte the spider. It taught me about loyalty and sacrifice.

entries.title: Spelling Bee Finalist
entries.details: I made it to the school spelling bee finals! The word 'phenomenon' got me, but I'm proud of reaching the top 5.

entries.title: The Magic Tree House
entries.details: Jack and Annie travel through time in a magic tree house. I read three books in this series and each adventure was exciting.
